fields.description: Also needs Auto Reconcile Payments ticked in Accounts Settings.
fields.label: Run Automatically

fields.description: Set by the Stop / Resume button. Stop stops all reconciliation: the scheduled job, Queued entries (Auto Reconcile Payments is unticked) and Running entries (they are paused). Resume starts them again. Started From is kept, so Resume also picks up entries made while stopped.
fields.label: Stopped

fields.description: Run once every this many hours.
fields.label: Run Every (Hours)

fields.description: Each run also resumes old Paused Process Payment Reconciliation entries, keeping at most 20 Running.
fields.label: Resume Paused Entries

fields.description: Only invoices and payments created after this time are picked up. Set when Run Automatically is ticked.
fields.label: Started From

fields.description: Process Payment Reconciliation entries that Stop paused. Resume starts only these, not older Paused entries.
fields.label: Paused by Stop
Auto Reconcile Payments Was On
fields.description: Whether Auto Reconcile Payments was ticked when Stop was pressed. Resume ticks it again only then.
